field.label: Interface
field.help: The interface whose port is controlled by 802.1X, usually WAN. For a tagged uplink, assign the VLAN device as the interface and select it here.

field.label: Inner authentication
field.help: PAP sends the password inside the TLS tunnel and is only available with TTLS.

field.label: Identity
field.help: The user name given by the network operator.

field.label: Outer identity
field.help: Identity sent outside the TLS tunnel, such as anonymous@example.com. Leave empty to send the identity above.

field.label: Certificate authority
field.help: Only accept an authentication server whose certificate is issued by this authority. Without it any server is accepted and the password can be captured by a rogue authenticator.

field.label: Server domain
field.help: Also require the server certificate to be issued for this domain or a subdomain of it.

field.label: EAPOL version
field.help: Some older switches only answer EAPOL version 1.
